notes.subject: namba bilong ves
notes.rationale: Tok Inglis Baibel i bagarapim dispela ves long 8:23 (wara bilong ai) na putim dispela long 9:2; MT i putim hia long 9:1.

notes.subject: ol i slip nogut wantaim meri bilong nariman
notes.rationale: מנאפים em i nogut pasin bilong braking marriage, na long profet em i tok tu long pasin bilong lusim Yahwe.

notes.subject: wanpela kain
notes.rationale: עצרת em i wanpela tok bilong olgeta man i kam wantaim; Tok Pisin i nidim tok bilong tok klia.

translation: Husat i ken givim mi long wailbus wanpela ples bilong slip bilong ol man i wokabaut? Na bai mi lusim ⟨את⟩ ol man bilong mi, na mi go we long ⟨את⟩ olgeta; bilong olgeta olgeta i slip nogut wantaim meri bilong nariman, wanpela kain olgeta ol giaman man.

tokens.gloss: ol i slip nogut wantaim meri bilong nariman
